Alice H: Heads up — release/2026.03 pipeline is failing on CI. The multi-arch build step errors out with a cache layer checksum mismatch between amd64 and arm64. This is blocking the canary cut scheduled in ~30m.

DeployBot: release-bot paused canary promotion for release/2026.03 — reason: pipeline failure (job: build-multiarch). Logs attached to job 8519.

Carla S: Pasted error from job: 
```
ERROR: failed to solve: failed to copy: unexpected EOF while reading blob "sha256:abc123..."
cache import: checksum mismatch expected sha256:abc123 got sha256:def456
```

Ben M: This looks like the shared registry cache got corrupted during concurrent pushes. Seen this before with buildx + remote cache on S3. Quick options: A) force clean build (no cache) B) pin base image digest to last-green and rerun C) attempt to repair the cache (slow/tricky).

Carla S: To reproduce locally: 
`docker buildx build --platform=linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --cache-from=type=registry,ref=registry.company/ci-cache:latest --cache-to=type=registry,mode=max,ref=registry.company/ci-cache:latest .`
Then inspect manifests: `skopeo inspect docker://registry.company/ci-cache:latest`

Ben M: If we do A (disable cache), job time +8m but predictable. If we do B (pin base digest), we get faster green but might mask other issues. Given change window, I'd prefer pin+rerun so we can meet the cutoff; then follow-up to clear/rotate cache.

Dana R: Reminder — if we pin the base image, we should call it out in the release notes and inform infra (we change which base digest we ship). Also need release-manager sign-off before canary proceeds.

Eric L: Agreed with Ben. Pin + rerun, then run canary. If rerun fails again, we do full no-cache rebuild. Don't want to rollback the whole release unless absolutely necessary.

Alice H: I'll open a hot PR to pin the base image and set NO_CACHE=1 only for the multi-arch job as a fallback env. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1428 — adding digest: ghcr.io/redwood/base@sha256:7f9d2c1b. Rerunning pipeline now.

DeployBot: Pipeline retriggered by Alice H — new run job id 8523 started. CI link: https://ci.company/8523

Ben M: I'll also run a small script to garbage-collect partial cache entries on S3 for the affected prefix (non-destructive, will only mark tombstones). Doing that now.

(10m later)

Ben M: CI is green on the rerun. Multi-arch images built with pinned base digest and cache disabled for that step. I cleaned several incomplete blobs from the cache; suspect a race.

Alice H: Canary cut resumed. Release bot requeued the promotion. ETA for canary to be healthy: ~15m.

Dana R: Adding note to release notes: "Hotfix: resolved multi-arch build cache checksum mismatch by forcing rebuild and pinning base image digest; no functional changes." Will also post to #incidents for visibility.

Eric L: Thanks everyone. After canary, we should schedule a short follow-up to rotate the cache and add a retry/validation step to the build job (checksum verification) so this fails earlier and more clearly.

Alice H: Agreed. Filing follow-up ticket: https://phab.company/T1234 — will include suggested fixes: cache rotation + pre-build cache validation + backoff for concurrent cache writes. :thumbsup:
